Correlation between body appreciation an.evidence_source: For Study X, female: "In women, body appreciation was significantly and positively correlated with life satisfaction (r=.47, p<.001) and self-esteem (r=.45, p<.001), and negatively correlated with weight discrepancy (r=-.36, p<.001) and BMI (r=-.19, p=.009).". For Study X, male: "In men, body appreciation was significantly and positively correlated with life satisfaction (r=.53, p<.001) and self-esteem (r=.48, p<.001). However, the correlation with BMI failed to reach significance (r=-.13, p=.093).". For Study Y, no correlation between body appreciation and BMI was reported.

section_summary.extract_value: This section presents further analyses on body appreciation. It first details an analysis (Study X) where body appreciation scores, derived from 10 items (likely BAS-2), were correlated with other variables, including BMI, separately for women and men. It then describes a secondary analysis (Study Y) using data from Swami and Ng (2015) involving a Cantonese version of the BAS-2, comparing it with a Standard Chinese version, with age and BMI entered as covariates.
